Introduction

NTB, formerly known as Naughty Boys, is a three-member boy group. Originally a seven-member group, they made their debut on August 3, 2016 in Japan with the single "DanCin'derella/Step By Step". The group later debuted in Korean on May 28, 2018 with the mini album "Dramatic".

While the group had originally disbanded in March of 2021, members Sangmin, Sungwoong, and Zio reformed the group into a trio on September 24, 2024.
